children: , activist investor Oasis Management raised its ownership in Vail Resorts
to 7.4% with the purchase of an additional 424K shares, according to a
with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
With an increased stake, Oasis Management is pursuing strategic changes at Vail Resorts
, board representation, and could propose a sale of the entire company or some of its resorts.
The fund nominated former Disney CEO Robert Chapek, Ashton Hudson, Bryce Roberts, and former Olympic skier Picabo Street to the Vail Resorts
board to “bring fresh perspective and relevant operating experience” to the company.
Plagued by poor weather conditions, declining pass sales, and lawsuits claiming the company artificially inflated day passes to drive demand for multi-day passes, Vail Resorts
has seen net income plummet by more than 40% over the past three years and its share price lose 43% of its value versus an 80% gain for the S&P 500.
After yet another quarter of “extremely unfavorable” weather conditions, Vail Resorts
lowered its outlook for FY26, with net income now expected to be between $128M and $162M, a -13% revision from the midpoint, and roughly half the net income reported in FY25.
